overall_summary: Data shows clear audience affinity for domestic and relationship dynamics (husband-wife realities), significantly outperforming generic sad shayari or random emotional topics.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,770 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,679 views) are massive outliers compared to sub-300 view videos.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on husband-wife psychological and emotional friction points.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framing a common dilemma or realization perform better than abstract shayari.
winning_patterns.action: Use specific second-person ('तुम', 'पति-पत्नी') relationship questions as hooks.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 21 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic or poetic Urdu/Hindi phrasing that lacks a concrete daily-life anchor.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos about siblings or pure self-motivation got low traction due to lack of focused repetition.
weak_patterns.action: Limit experimentation outside the core high-performing relationship segment.
